__comment: Star forge core (DESIGN step 28, the author chose A "Heir of the torus" on 2026-10-29; stage 11.5 made it of the add-on's own parts): a torus coil (four until stage 14, when the coil grew ten times dearer), so the forge grows out of the torus as the torus grew out of the reactor; reflector elements to keep the star's light in, reinforced plates and palladium foil; the Voltex heat network (heat ports, advanced heat exchangers, thermal insulation) for a machine that runs on heat; plasma cores; liquid helium from the torus. In the Voltex assembler, 90 s at 16 000 FE/t.
